description: Address 3 review issues: (1) SSRF protection on /api/fetch-image, (2) credential gate on manual translate paths, (3) strip-mode undo snapshot before bubble update.
steps: 1. In backend/app/routers/fetch_image.py: add _is_private_url helper that validates scheme is http/https and resolves hostname to check for private/loopback/link-local IPs. Call it at top of endpoint handler before making httpx request.
2. In features/translator/useTranslatePipeline.ts: add checkCredentials() helper and call it at start of handleTranslateImage, handleTranslateAll, and retryImage.
3. In store/useSessionStore.ts: add pushBubbleSnapshotForImage(imageId: string) method that snapshots a specific image's bubbles.
4. In App.tsx: update strip-mode onBubbleUpdate to call pushBubbleSnapshotForImage before updateBubbleForImage.
acceptance_criteria: fetch_image endpoint rejects private/internal URLs with 400
handleTranslateImage, handleTranslateAll, retryImage check credentials before processing
Strip-mode bubble edits push undo snapshot before mutating
findings: All 3 review fixes implemented and verified. Typecheck and build pass. SSRF protection uses socket.getaddrinfo to resolve hostnames and rejects private/loopback/link-local/reserved IPs. Credential check helper is shared across handleTranslateImage, handleTranslateAll, and retryImage. pushBubbleSnapshotForImage added to store and called in strip-mode onBubbleUpdate.
